summary: Thorough re-testing of InfoPilot Explorer completed. All 26 backend API tests passed (100%). All UI flows verified working correctly including login, registration, Google OAuth button, navigation, Ultimate Search with RENAME PAGE modal, PHOTOS button, Google Maps with markers, Category CRUD with edit/delete, Book page with 5 clickable thumbnails, and responsive design across Desktop/Tablet/Mobile viewports.

issues: Admin panel is minimal - only shows 'SYSTEM STATUS' section with basic text. Could benefit from more admin features like blocked words management, user management, settings controls.
Found 5 thumbnail images instead of 6 mentioned in requirements. The main image + 5 thumbnails = 6 total images are present, but only 5 are in the thumbnail row.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is very large (2000+ lines) - consider splitting into separate component files for maintainability
ESLint warnings about missing dependencies in useEffect hooks should be addressed
Google OAuth button uses @react-oauth/google library - 'Continue with Google' button is present and functional
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_Category during testing, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features thoroughly tested and working. Key verifications: Login/logout works, Registration form has CALLSIGN/EMAIL/PASSWORD fields, Google OAuth 'Continue with Google' button present, Ultimate Search has RENAME PAGE modal (tested saving new name), PHOTOS (0/26) button with upload modal, Google Maps with markers and category color key, Category tree with checkboxes and '+ Add subcategory' links, AND/OR/AND radio buttons, Document Types checkboxes, AI Search section, SEARCH and SEARCH & COLLATE buttons. Book page shows 5 thumbnails (clickable, changes main image), genre 'A True Supernatural Thriller Comedy', 19 Five-Star Reviews, BUY ON AMAZON, OFFICIAL SITE, READ REVIEWS buttons. Subscription page shows LIFETIME ACCESS ACTIVE for premium users. Safe Browsing API working. Mobile hamburger menu works. Protected routes redirect unauthenticated users. Session persists across page refresh.
